This information seemed to be credible and strong and if raid is conducted near Oriental Cinema, Bhai Randhir Singh Nagar, Ludhiana then above mentioned persons along with fake currency notes can be apprehended.

According to the information received I ASI along with other police officials above mentioned persons were seen in i20 car white color bearing no. I ASI tried to join independent witness from public, but no one was ready to join.

sentences.text: The petitioner was simply a driver of the car.
A co-accused, namely, Bakhtaur Singh had been granted the concession of interim anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 13.02.2024 (Annexure P-6).

As the petitioner was a first-time offender,
in custody since 03.01.2024 and none of the 15 prosecution witnesses had been examined so far, the Trial of the present case was not likely to be concluded in the near future.
Therefore, he was entitled to the concession of bail.
4. The learned counsel for the State, on the other hand, contends that a huge quantity of fake notes came to be recovered from the vehicle of which the petitioner was a driver.
Therefore, the offence was prima facie established against the petitioner and his co-accused.

He, however, concedes that the petitioner was a first-time offender, in custody since 03.01.2024, none of the 15 prosecution witnesses had been examined and that a co-accused/Bakhtaur Singh had been granted the concession of interim anticipatory bail vide order dated 13.02.2024 (Annexure P-6).
5. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties.
 3 of 4  Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:03631  2024:PHHC:036314 CRM-M-11946-2024 (O& M) ::4::
6.
The veracity of the prosecution case against the petitioner and his co-accused shall be adjudicated upon during the course of the Trial.
Admittedly, he is a first-time offender, in custody since 03.01.2024 and none of the 15 prosecution witnesses have been examined so far.
Therefore, the Trial of the present case is not likely to be concluded in the near future.

In this situation, the further incarceration of the petitioner is not required, moreso, when a co-accused has been granted the concession of interim anticipatory bail vide order dated 13.02.2024 (Annexure P-6).
7.

Thus without commenting on the merits of the case, the present petition is allowed and the petitioner-Sohan Singh @ Soni is ordered to be released on bail subject to his furnishing bail bonds and surety bonds to the satisfaction of learned CJM/Duty Magistrate, concerned.

8. The petitioner shall appear before the police station concerned on the first Monday of every month till the conclusion of the trial and inform in writing each time that he is not involved in any other case/crime other than the present one.
9.

In addition, the petitioner (or anyone on his behalf) shall prepare an FDR in the sum of Sohan Singh @ Soni vs State Of Punjab on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10234073/
3 Rs.1,00,000/- and deposit the same with the Trial Court.
